question: Which records of this object changed recently, and who changed them?

steps.name: records
steps.soql: SELECT {fields} FROM {obj} WHERE LastModifiedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:{days} [[AND LastModifiedBy.Username = '{user}']] ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: No {obj} changed in the last {days} day(s).

traps: Integration users and automation also change records; LastModifiedBy names the user the change ran as.
